Post 1
📉 ASX 200 snapped lower Tuesday, shedding 90.10pts or 1.00% to 8,920.80 — a fresh 20-day low. Consumer and tech led the selloff. The index is now 4.04% off its 52-week high. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2
🔻 Consumer Discretionary worst sector, -1.88%. IT -1.76%, Financials -1.63%. Only Utilities +0.59% and Health Care +0.45% held green. Risk-off rotation was broad and decisive. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 3
BSL crushed, -5.84% to AUD 30.66. BlueScope led all declines as steel margins face global pressure. Treasury Wine also hit -4.12%. Cyclicals took the sharpest pain today. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 4
🪙 Gold at AUD 6,160.96/oz as the AUD/USD sits 0.7217. Silver AUD 92.74/oz, Platinum AUD 2,540.68/oz. Metals holding firm even as equities sold off. #gold #metals #ASX

Post 5
ASX down 1.61% over five days and sitting at a 20-day low. The line in the sand is 8,900. Does it hold or does the index retest lower? Drop your level below. #ASX #ausbiz #trading
